artworks.title: Sts. Chrysanthus & Daria; Sts. Crispin & Crispinian; St. Evaristus; St. Frumentius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes depicted within oval frames. The four illustrations each feature different characters and actions taking place, accompanied by a date and some text. The first image shows three figures engaged in a religious ritual or event. The second scene depicts two figures engaged in a craft or trade. The third illustration features a figure wearing a tall headpiece, standing in a landscape with ancient buildings, while the last image portrays a figure near a tree with buildings in the background, engaging with two other figures. The scenes are detailed with lines suggesting textures and shadows, giving a sense of depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Sts. Simon and Jude, Apostles; St. Narcissus; St. Marcellus; St. Quintin
artworks.description: Four oval illustrations depict religious figures, possibly saints. Each illustration shows figures from head to toe. The top left features one person gesturing upwards next to a structure with another figure reclining above them, surrounded by architectural elements. The top right illustrates a bearded individual standing amidst distant buildings. The bottom left shows a person in profile holding torches, surrounded by classical architecture. The bottom right displays a figure draped in a cloak amongst buildings. Each scene includes architectural elements.

artworks.title: St. Benignus; Festival of All Saints; Commemoration of the Dead; St. Hubert
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes. The image consists of four circular vignettes, each illustrating a different scene. The top-left panel shows a figure in robes gesturing towards an architectural setting with classical buildings. The top-right panel depicts a radiant figure surrounded by onlookers, emitting divine light. The bottom-left panel features a figure kneeling in a natural setting with a stag, while a dog stands nearby. The bottom-right panel shows multiple figures ascending through clouds towards the heavens. The scenes are labeled with Latin phrases and numerals, indicating scenes corresponding to specific dates in November.

artworks.title: St. Emeric; St. Charles Borromeo; St. Vitalis & Agricola; Sts. Zachary & Elizabeth
artworks.description: This is a group of four oval prints contained in rectangles, arranged in a grid. In the top left panel, two people are embracing; one wearing a cape and a halo, and the other in a robe. Architecture with archways and columns is in the background, under a cloudy sky. To the right, another panel shows a full-length profile view of a kneeling man with a robe and a halo at an altar. The altar has a book on top of it, and an opening with people in the background is visible on the left. The bottom left panel features two almost nude men; one on the left is tied to a cross and the other on the right is bound to a post, with a cityscape visible behind them. They both have halos and are looking upward, where an angelic figure with wings hovers in a cloud above them. Finally, the bottom right panel includes three people: a bearded man with a halo, a long robe, and a large hat with two curved points, a woman with a head covering, a halo, and a draped tunic, and a child with a halo wearing a tunic, holding a tall cross in one hand, the other held up, palm outward. Each oval print is surrounded by a few words and numbers, with large blank borders between them.

artworks.title: Sts. Philoteus and Theotimus; St. Leonard; St. Florentinus; St. Godfrey
artworks.description: The image contains four separate illustrations within oval frames. In the top left panel, two figures stand facing each other holding palm branches in a barren landscape with architectural ruins. Both have halos above their heads and wear long robe-like garments. In the top right panel, a figure sits under trees in a devotional posture, holding an object, with other figures walking in the background. The bottom left panel features a bearded figure standing outdoors with a halo, accompanied by animals and a building. The bottom right panel shows a figure with a halo offering a bowl to a person lying in bed in a simple room setting with wooden paneling and a small bench. Each panel emphasizes a distinct scene with religious symbols and attire.

artworks.title: St. Castorius; St. Carpophorus & The Four Crowned Martyrs; Commemoration of the Image of Christ; St. Theodore
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four separate scenes depicted within oval frames. The top left scene shows two figures in conversation near a building with a vine-like plant in view. The top right scene displays a barren landscape with two fallen figures among camels and an oncoming group of individuals holding spears. The bottom left scene shows a central figure mounted on a cross while several others are present in the background. The bottom right scene presents one figure gesturing towards another who is seated in a confined space under a barred window.

artworks.title: St. Martin; St. Tryphon and Companions; St. Renatus; St. Didacus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes. The drawing features four oval frames, each containing a distinct religious scene with corresponding inscriptions. The top left scene depicts a man being martyred on a city street, with two others in the background, and inscriptions reading 'S. TRYPHON' and 'ET SOCII MM'. Below is written 'NOV.' The top right scene shows a mounted figure giving his cloak to a half-clad person, with inscriptions 'S. MARTI^' and 'EPISC'. The bottom left scene shows an individual preaching in a cathedral, with 'S. RENATUS EPISC' and '12. NOV.'. The lower right scene shows a figure holding a cross in a pastoral setting, with the inscription 'SANC. DIDACUS' and '12. NOV.'.

artworks.title: St. Brice; St. Serapion; St. Eugenius; St. Edmund
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of four religious scenes depicted in oval frames. The artwork is divided into four sections, each illustrating a different scene with distinct compositions and characters. 

1. The first frame features an ecclesiastical figure and a child interacting with sheep under a tree.

2. The second frame shows a figure appearing to fall or be confronted by a hand with architectural elements in the background.

3. In the third frame, two figures are depicted near a rocky outcrop.

4. The fourth frame includes a saintly figure standing on a pedestal handing something to another person with onlookers in the background.

artworks.title: St. Gregory; Sts. Romanus & Barulla; Dedication of the Basilicas of Sts. Peter & Paul; St. Elizabeth
artworks.description: This drawing shows four religious scenes depicted in an oval frame format, each associated with different saints and events. The four scenes are arranged in a grid of two by two, with a description in Latin above and a date below. The top-left scene shows St. Gregory performing a miracle, casting out devils from a tower. The top-right scene features Saints Romanus and Barula, seemingly depicting a martyrdom. The bottom-left vignette represents the dedication of the Churches of Sts. Peter and Paul, with a crowned figure participating in a ceremonial activity. The bottom-right displays St. Elizabeth of Hungary in an act of charity. Each scene is delicately etched, with attention to attire and actions but minimalistic in background details.

artworks.title: Edmund, King of England, Martyr; Presentation of the Virgin; St. Columban; St. Cecelia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four scenes, each contained within an oval and accompanied by text and date. The first scene shows a robed figure under a tree facing an armed individual. The second scene depicts a figure ascending steps into a temple-like structure. The third scene illustrates a bearded figure kneeling with animals nearby. The last scene portrays a haloed figure seated at a table with a book, looking upwards towards angelic beings in the clouds. The artwork is detailed, using line work to convey form and shading, with each image labeled with names and dates.

artworks.title: St. Clement; St. Lucretia; St. Chrysogonus; St. Catharine
artworks.description: The image is a print consisting of four oval illustrations, each depicting a different scene. In the top left, a man floats in water near the shore with three figures nearby. In the top right, a kneeling female figure with a halo is accompanied by a person holding a sword. In the bottom left, a man is shown by the water seemingly pulling a lifeless body from it. In the bottom right, two winged figures support a seated woman with a halo, against a background of light beams and a plain sky. Each scene is in a separate oval with minimalistic foregrounds and backgrounds highlighting the central figures.

artworks.title: St. Mercury; St. Peter of Alexandria; St. Conrad; Sts. Barlaam and Josaphat
artworks.description: Four oval illustrations of religious or historical scenes surrounded by rectangular frames. The top left illustration is labeled "S. Mercvrivs Miles," showing an armored figure gesturing towards a flying angel holding a spear, with horsemen in the background. The top right illustration, labeled "S. Petrvs Alexandrinvs M.," shows two figures, one kneeling and reaching towards the other. The bottom left, labeled "S. Conradvs EPVS.," depicts a figure in ecclesiastical attire seemingly blessing or gesturing towards a kneeling figure with antlers sprouting from the head. The bottom right image, labeled "S. Barlaam et Iosaphat," illustrates two figures in a cave, one standing and the other kneeling in prayer. The drawings are minimally detailed with minimal shading, focusing on the depiction of the figures and their interactions, in a style reminiscent of 16th to 17th-century European religious engravings.

artworks.title: St. Liverius; St. Saturninus; St. Joscion; St. Andrew
artworks.description: The image contains four engravings, each depicting a different figure within an oval frame. The top-left engraving shows a figure labeled "S. LIVERVS MAR." The top-right engraving features "S. SATVRNIVS EPISC.M." The bottom-left engraving displays "S. TOSCION MONAC." The bottom-right engraving illustrates "S. ANDREA APOST.EM." Each engraving includes a title at the top and a date at the bottom.

artworks.title: St. Eligius; St. Agericus; St. Francis Xavier; St. Peter Chrysologus
artworks.description: Four oval illustrations are depicted. In the upper left, a man is shown engaged in metalwork at a table. In the upper right, two women are kneeling in prayer among grass, with another figure in the distance. In the lower left, a haloed man holds lilies against a maritime background. In the lower right, a man with a halo gestures while holding a book, with a city behind him. Each illustration is framed in its section and labeled with inscriptions and decorative elements against a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: St. Bibiana; St. Birinus; St. Barbara; St. Sabbas
artworks.description:
The image shows four illustrations of saints associated with the month of December. Each illustration is framed in an oval and depicts the saints with partial to full bodies shown.

In the top left illustration, labeled "S. BIBIANA VIRG. ET M.," two figures are shown in full body; one is a female figure being tied to a column by another figure.

The top right illustration, marked "S. BIRINUS EPVS," displays a single standing figure with a halo, holding a circular object and dressed in a long robe.

In the bottom left image, labeled "S. BARBARA VIR. ET M.," a woman is shown standing, partially holding a large palm frond with a halo above her head.

The illustration in the bottom right corner, titled "S. SABBAS ABB," depicts a man in profile, walking into a cave or rocky area, his full body shown.

artworks.title: St. Nicholas; St. Dionisia and Son; St. Agatha; Conception of the Virgin
artworks.description:
Four oval illustrations of religious scenes are depicted. 
The top left image shows a bishop character holding a crozier, children in a barrel beside them, and church towers in the background. 
In the top right illustration, three figures are shown with palm branches in a dramatic scene with beams of light shining down on the central figure. 
The lower left image features two figures with halos and another individual seated on a pedestal holding a sword-like object. 
The lower right illustration shows a central figure standing on crescent-shaped clouds surrounded by radiant beams above, with a distant cityscape and hills in the background. 
The images are detailed with line work and shading, conveying a sense of narrative and religious symbolism. Latin text and numerical markings accompany each scene.

artworks.title: St. Romaricus; St. Leocadia; Sts. Mennas and Hermogenes; St. Damasus
artworks.description:
The image shows four oval illustrations on a single sheet, divided into four sections.

1. The upper left oval depicts "S. ROMARICUS ABBAS" holding a book, set against a background of a town with a tower and trees.

2. The upper right oval features "S. LEOCADIA VIRG. ET M." kneeling in front of a crucifix against a wall with a barred window.

3. The lower left oval shows "SS. MÆNNAS ET HERMO. GENES M." two male figures holding palm branches.

4. The lower right oval contains "S. DAMASUS PAP" in a papal tiara and robe, with another figure standing in the background.

artworks.title: Sts. Maxentius & Leander; Sts. Sergius & Paul; Sts. Eustratius & Orestes; St. Lucy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes depicted in separate oval frames as if part of a calendar. The upper left scene shows two figures under a cloud, with one bound to a vertical structure and another holding a weapon. The frame is labeled "S. MAXENTIUS ET LEANDER," with the number 12 and the term "Decem." In the upper right frame, a person with a halo is kneeling while another stands over, pouring from a container. This scene is labeled "S. SERGIUS PAVLVS," marked with the number 12 and "Decem." The lower left frame shows a dramatic scene where two figures are near a fire, with one appearing to be bound and suspended above the flames. It is labeled "S. EUSTRATIUS ET ORESTES," with the number 13 and "Decem." The lower right frame shows a kneeling figure, haloed, being approached by two other figures in an outdoor setting. It is titled "S. LVCIA VIR ET MAR," with the number 13 and "Decem." Each scene contains an inscription "Israel ex."

artworks.title: St. Othilia; Sts. Nicasius & Eutropia; St. Agnelus; Sts. Thyrsus & Callinicus
artworks.description: The image consists of four separate engravings featuring religious figures within oval frames. Each oval is labeled with Latin names and dates in December. The first oval shows a figure labeled "S. Othilia Virg." The second oval features figures labeled "SS. Nicasius et Eutropia M." The third engraving displays a figure labeled "S. Agnellus Abbas." The fourth oval has figures labeled "SS. Thyrs et Gallinicus M." Each engraving is illustrated with a simple background and styled in black and white linework.

artworks.title: St. Irene & Companions; St. Christiana; Sts. Anania, Azaria & Misael; St. Florianus & Companions
artworks.description: This image shows four religious scenes depicted in historical illustration style. The top-left panel features a figure with a halo kneeling, facing another figure with an axe, with a small group of people in the background. The top-right panel shows a haloed figure gesturing towards two other figures near a structure. The bottom-left panel depicts three haloed figures in a cave-like setting surrounded by other figures. The bottom-right panel shows a chaotic scene with multiple figures, one with a halo, surrounded by figures holding weapons. Each panel is labeled with Latin names and dates at the top.

artworks.title: Waiting for the Virgin to Give Birth; St. Nemesius; St. Philogonius; St. Thomas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four separate scenes within oval frames, each depicting a different biblical or historical event. The first scene is an interior view of a stable with a seated figure facing an altar and a cow in the background. The second scene shows a celestial event with a central figure surrounded by clouds and two attendants holding sticks. The third scene portrays a robed figure outside a building gesturing towards a group of people engaged in discourse. The fourth scene features a figure holding a staff with a boat in the background on a cloudy day. Labels such as "Expectatio Deiparae" and "Partus Vir." are included, indicating religious or saintly themes tied to specific days in December.

artworks.title: St. Flavian; St. Victoria; St. Servulus; St. Tharsilla
artworks.description:
This is a drawing with four vignettes depicting religious scenes. Each vignette is contained within an oval shape, showing different scenes related to martyrdom or divine visions.

1. The top left illustration shows a soldier holding a weapon against someone tied to a post under a sky with sparse clouds and a rocky formation in the background.

2. The top right vignette portrays a figure reclining under a beam of light coming through the clouds with a small heavenly figure in the sky. There's a simple architectural structure in the surroundings.

3. The bottom left image presents a heavenly scene in the clouds above a reclining person observed by another figure sitting nearby. A building is depicted in the earthly scene below.

4. The bottom right illustrates a bed-ridden person under a depiction of saints or holy figures with halos among clouds, invoking a sense of a divine or spiritual occurrence.

The drawings use lines and shading to create depth and texture, emphasizing the central figures and their interactions. Text on the images indicates specific saints and dates, providing contextual references.

artworks.title: The Nativity; St. Stephen; St. John; Holy Innocents
artworks.description: This is a drawing of biblical scenes. The image is divided into four oval panels. The top left panel shows the Nativity scene. The top right panel depicts a martyrdom scene. The bottom left panel shows a figure with an open book near water, with an eagle nearby. The bottom right panel shows a chaotic urban scene with figures in distress. The line work is intricate and each panel is detailed with complementary backgrounds.

artworks.title: St. David, King and Prophet; Sts. Sabinus and Venustianus; St. Sylvester; St. Colomba
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious-themed illustrations. The drawing is in a classical style, typical of a series of illustrations depicting religious figures or saints.
